The lighter on the right is inactive, appearing as a solid light blue rectangular block with a faint white label area. There is visible digital text overlay in the lower center of the image.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a string of nonsensical characters ('O ZVZP...') floating on the wooden background. This is a common AI artifact where the model attempts to render text or labels but fails to produce legible words.

The surface of the blue lighter is unnaturally smooth and lacks the subtle micro-scratches, molding lines, or reflection variations expected on mass-produced plastic. It has a 'waxy' or digitally painted appearance.

The metal wind guard and ignition mechanism on the active lighter are slightly malformed. The geometry of the spark wheel housing is indistinct and merges softly with the plastic collar, lacking the sharp mechanical edges of a real manufactured part.
